title: Uniform Prediction-Risk Bands over Predictor Weights in Synthetic Control
banked_reason: Stage 0.5 typed BELOW NOVELTY FLOOR: cold tier subfield below field; no bounded fix was accepted in scope.
gap_reasons: The exact minimax characterization and attainment are proved only for compact iid-Gaussian local neighborhoods; over the full stationary mixing class the note proves a uniformly root-n projection band and a one-sided local lower bound, but no matching globally honest attaining procedure.
The note reports no nontrivial multidimensional numerical computation beyond the binary hinge calculation.

Practical significance is also limited by the block-stable fixed-rank model and the absence of a worked synthetic-control application or computational performance evidence for the exponentially large acceptance-subset programs.
total-variation convergence of the central score and a maximal common-part coupling do not by themselves give a reverse kernel uniformly for the exponentially tilted family
proof_attempt_summary: The derivation built the identified prediction-risk graph, a uniformly valid same-panel projection band, the moving-face critical-cone limit, and convergent LP/SOCP bounds for the compact-local iid-Gaussian minimax problem. The field claim collapsed at D0.5 because full-class attainment, a nontrivial multidimensional certified computation, and an applied demonstration were absent; the panel also left the reverse transfer-kernel argument and theorem positioning unrepaired.
tldr: Predictor weighting changes both the donor face and the future counterfactual performance of a synthetic control. This paper identifies the entire population prediction-MSE graph from the stated block-stable fixed-rank panel, constructs a uniformly valid root-\(n\) same-panel band over the predictor simplex, and computes the exact compact-local iid-Gaussian minimax expected maximum width through finite KKT-cell, conic-distance, and primal--dual linear programs with certified vanishing error. Exact attainment is local to the specified Gaussian neighborhoods; the global projection band is validity-only. Every procedure uniformly honest over the full panel class nevertheless obeys the computed local lower bound because that honesty requirement contains the Gaussian paths.
gap: VivesiBastida2022PredictorSelection and PouliotXieLiu2026DegreesFreedom make predictor selection operational but do not attach an honest population-risk certificate to every candidate weighting. CanenSong2026SimplexWeight treats one fixed simplex objective. FreybergerRai2018UniformBands restricts attention to bands induced by a nonrandom-shape set and develops low-level sufficient conditions and a worked approximation for weighted area; other minimum-size confidence-set results treat scalar linear targets or additive set-measure losses. None addresses an unrestricted externally randomized max-curve-diameter decision for a piecewise-affine risk curve whose KKT face moves with the local query.
fill: The project combines row-span completion, a joint block-mean and covariance expansion, exact shifted-QP inversion, critical-cone curve geometry, certified finite primal and dual decision programs, and a matching local asymptotic lower-bound and attainment transfer from the actual observed Gaussian panel.
